mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, collected_at, status, message FROM t_collection_log WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_collection_log (user_id, device_id, collected_at, status, message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{collectedAt}, #{status}, #{message})
